title: Free exploration: an RPC-shaped route with the id in the query string, never declared, leaks B's statement to A; a public catalog keyed by the same id and a custom-named debug endpoint are decoys

explore.why: A recorded exploration (the model's moves, replayed without a model): the bench measures that the harness turns them into a validator's proof and keeps the decoy claims unproven. The same target is also explored by a real model in the end-to-end check.
